name: Metal-Ligand Coordination SPE Agent
description: Calculates supported metal complexes with explicit oxidation-state, charge, spin-state, coordination-geometry, and method-suitability checks.
validation_checks: oxidation states and ligand charges reconcile with total charge
method basis ECP and relativistic choices support every element
coordination geometry has no obvious invalid contacts
scientific_constraints: oxidation state and spin are not changed automatically
all-electron and ECP descriptions are not mixed inconsistently
one spin-state energy is not claimed to establish the ground state
acceptance_criteria: SCF converges to the requested state
finite energy and available spin diagnostics are extracted
method and element coverage checks pass
coordination and electronic-state warnings are reported
capability_boundaries: does not assign oxidation state from geometry alone
does not guarantee multireference systems are described adequately
does not compare spin states unless matched alternative-state jobs are supplied
recovery_actions: apply a supported level shift damping or orbital guess strategy while preserving the scientific state
human_review_when: oxidation or spin state is ambiguous
metal basis ECP or relativistic treatment is unsupported
SCF converges to the wrong state
